evidence.detail: Current selected Opera Neon exposes fill, click, press_key, new_page, evaluate_script, upload_file and list_pages. Live list_pages succeeded on 2026-10-01. Historical Browser not connected is a connection-state error; its original cause is UNKNOWN. This observation records routing/capability evidence, not aesthetic acceptance or a promoted global rule.
evidence.summary: Previous claim that Opera Neon lacks input/send operations is contradicted by the current tool inventory and live connection.
